The gate is shown to see connectivity by --seed-regioisomer (ester C19->C18: identical formula, identical exact mass, different key).

The paper DOES draw this lipid, but the panel is 130 x 70 px inside a 708 x 391 px figure, the only copy obtainable (Europe PMC fulltextRepo returned an HTML error page and the PMC OA service 404'd; no bot check was bypassed). At that size the 2,5-diketopiperazine with its two ring carbonyls and two NH, the two tertiary nitrogens, the four CH2-CH(OH)-R arms and their 'C10H21' labels are all legible and CONSISTENT with the emitted structure -- but the methylene count of each lysine side chain, the one thing an anchor exists to test, is not resolvable, and counting it by eye is what this project forbids. No anchor is better than a guessed one.
